title: Dwarf building looks: the Mushroom Farm (Farm) and the Steam Pump (Windmill)

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the colours of the mushroom caps: every cap becomes a warm tan brown (#b98a55) or a russet brown (#8a5a34) with small cream spots, with no red, no pink and no green caps anywhere. Keep the mushrooms, their cream stalks, the three strips of brown soil, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: mushroom-flux-b has the right shapes (three thin beds of six mushrooms) but red and green caps.

recipes.promptAddendum: The mound is ringed by a low border of small grey stones. The mushrooms are drawn large: the tall one is about two thirds of the image tall. Nothing touches an edge of the image.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only one thing: the thick square block of dark earth under the mushrooms becomes one low flat rounded mound of dark brown mulch, thin, with no tall side walls and no green grass on it. Keep every mushroom, the caps and their cream spots, the cream stalks, the small spade, the crooked wooden signpost, the size, the colours, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
